cases.prompt: Write a Detox test for our React Native login screen.
expectations: Adds testID props to the components and matches them with by.id.
Launches or reloads the app in beforeAll or beforeEach.
Runs against a local browser, emulator or app; it does not require a hosted cloud grid or vendor account.

cases.prompt: Configure Detox for an iOS simulator and an Android emulator.
expectations: Defines apps, devices and configurations for ios.sim and android.emu.
Includes build commands and binary paths.
Shows detox build and detox test commands.
